_meta.source: https://github.com/Btd6ModHelper/btd6-game-data (BTD Mod Helper "Export Game Data"), game v56.0
_meta.groupFormat: [bloon id (see bloons.json), count, start s, end s, spacing s]; times = game frames / 60, before mode speed. spacing = (end-start)/(count-1) (inferred: first spawn at start, last at end).
_meta.rowFields: rbe/leak/cashRaw = sum over groups with the export tree; cashPop = cashRaw x popMult (IncomeSets/DefaultIncomeSet). late = R81+ values under overrides (Super Ceramic, one child, blimp HP ramp). End-of-round bonus (100 + round) is NOT included.

incomeSet.rule: pop cash x multiplier of the first threshold with round <= threshold (1-based); else final
